messages:
nora (sec): Heads-up: partner public bucket contained a Vault transit ciphertext blob referencing svc acct partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com. We should evict access and rewrap. tagging: @dev @sam @lee

dev (sre): thanks. which secret path and KMS key? any signs of plaintext exposure?

nora (sec): secret path secret/data/partners/acme/webhooks, wrapped-by kms projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-old. object: gs://partner-shared/2026-03-22/webhook-enc.blob. starts with vault:v1: so looks transit-wrapped. Bucket was public ~9h.

sam (platform): good, transit means we can rewrap without plaintext. plan: 1) remove partner SA binding, 2) provision new key in our control, 3) dry-run rewrap to temp path, 4) swap and rotate downstream creds.

lee (oncall): i'll open INC-3331 and schedule a 25m window at 19:00 PT. will set heartbeat 5m and page if error rate >2% for 10m.

dev (sre): rewrap dry-run pseudocode:

```bash
C=$(vault kv get -field=ciphertext secret/partners/acme/webhooks)
NEW=$(vault write -field=ciphertext transit/rewrap key=new-partner-wrap ciphertext=$C)
vault kv put secret/temp/partners/acme/webhooks ciphertext=$NEW
```

dev (sre): validate by hitting the downstream auth endpoint with test token. if green, perform the live swap and then rotate upstream credentials. Also snapshot vault first: `vault snapshot save /tmp/pre-rewrap.snap`.

nora (sec): also search GCS logs for `Authorization:` and `Bearer` in the 12h window and request partner rotate any tokens they control. I'll run `gsutil ls` + grep and post results to INC-3331.

sam (platform): i'll create new KMS key `new-partner-wrap` with restricted IAM (only vault SA) and set log retention for projects/acme-prod to 90d. will PR the IAM change and the retention bump.

pager-bot: alert - IAM binding change detected for partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-23T18:05:12Z. Reference INC-3331.

lee (oncall): rollback: if rewrap or writes fail, restore snapshot and reapply old SA binding. keep original ciphertext artifacts in locked bucket for forensics.

dev (sre): small note: some clients will re-encrypt on request and could create a burst. recommend running low-traffic maintenance window and monitor token error spikes.

nora (sec): thanks team. i'll coordinate partner notification + legal. posting final checklist and dry-run output in INC-3331 before go-time.
